PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 23, 2025
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PARKS, RECREATION AND MARINE ADMINISTRATION
  OFFICE, 4:30 PM

Susan Redfield, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Silissa Uriarte Smith, Vice Chair  Robert Livingstone, Commissioner
Cory Allen, Commissioner  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner

Brent Dennis, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  CHRISTINE.AMAYA@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54146  Authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to execute a Right-of-Entry
  Permit, and any other necessary documents, with McCormick Divers, a California
  for profit business, to relocate their dry-land diving equipment from the Martin
  Luther King Jr. Park Pool (MLK Pool) to the Silverado Park Pool and return back to
  the MLK Pool for a six month period between January 27, 2025 and July 31, 2025
  or until the completion of the MLK Pool construction project. (District 6,7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
 is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

 ANNOUNCEMENTS

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
 prior to the meeting.

Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 4:32 PM, Chair Redfield called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Allen, Higa, Schoen, Uriarte Smith, Redfield

 Commissioners Absent: Chavez, Livingstone

 Also present: Brent Dennis, Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, Stephen Scott, Deputy
 Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine, Gladys Kaiser, Bureau Manager, Sherlyn Beatty, Bureau
 Manager, Eric Woodson, Bureau Manager, Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant, Christine Amaya,
 Administrative Aide.

 Commissioner Chavez and Commissioner Livingstone are excused from the meeting.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54146  Authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to execute a Right-of-Entry
  Permit, and any other necessary documents, with McCormick Divers, a California
  for profit business, to relocate their dry-land diving equipment from the Martin
  Luther King Jr. Park Pool (MLK Pool) to the Silverado Park Pool and return back to
  the MLK Pool for a six month period between January 27, 2025 and July 31, 2025
  or until the completion of the MLK Pool construction project. (District 6,7)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Schoen, seconded by
  Commissioner Allen, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  5 Allen, Higa, Schoen, Uriarte Smith, Redfield
  No:  0 None
